outcome: Spectrum of disease requiring ICU admission
cohort: 210 pregnant and postpartum patients admitted to the ICU at Dr George Mukhari Academic Hospital, South Africa, between January 2008 and December 2011
finding: Cardiac disease in pregnancy was the most common reason for ICU admission (44.3%), followed by eclampsia and preeclampsia (20%), and most patients (87.1%) were haemodynamically stable and required minimal intervention.
mod_finding: 88.6% of patients admitted to the ICU were post-cesarean section.
gest_age: 25.33 weeks (for the 12 patients admitted during pregnancy)
